# نَتَشَابَكَ (natašābaka) /na.ta.ʃaː.ba.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَابَكَ (tašābaka)
# نَتَشَابَكْ (natašābak) /na.ta.ʃaː.bak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَابَكَ (tašābaka)
